name: Domhnach
text: Domhnach is a Modern Irish oral-tradition variant of the head Demne Máel. MacKillop treats the name as a phonetic reformulation whose folk currency rests on oral transmission rather than literary attestation. The entry functions as a cross-reference. Readers seeking the full material should consult the PCE node for Demne Máel. That node carries the MacKillop dossier for that head.

okr.objective: Domhnach as the Modern Irish oral variant of Demne Máel.
